about: The failure catalogue cc-failures records against: kind = <contract>/<symptom>, the broken contract and what was seen, never the guessed cause. Six to start, five more from phase 2's writers (cc-green, cc-land, cc-loop, cc-scope deliver) (docs/design-failure-noticing-2026-09-11.md); it grows by use. `match` is a list of regexes over a board row's name: `cc-failures import` files a raised- row or an INSTANCE line under the first kind whose regex matches, else under the row's own family (board-row/<row>). A miss is a false split, a wrong hit a false match; `cc-failures metrics <fixture>` measures both.

answer-evidence/wrong-object-or-proxy.contract: an answer to a person rests on the record for the exact object it is about
answer-evidence/wrong-object-or-proxy.symptom: the answer rested on a proxy (a public read, a typed list, an empty output, an earlier case) and was wrong

gate-target/wrong-revision.contract: a gate runs on the revision it is reporting on
gate-target/wrong-revision.symptom: the gate ran on another tree or ref (a lagging fetch, a stale checkout, a copy) and its verdict was read as the branch's

guard-policy/permitted-text-refused.contract: the guard judges the command, and permits what the policy permits
guard-policy/permitted-text-refused.symptom: a permitted command was refused on words in its text (a heredoc body, a grep pattern, a path) and cost a turn

handoff-input/existing-record-not-found.contract: a session finds the record its predecessor left (a handoff, a journal, a ledger row)
handoff-input/existing-record-not-found.symptom: an existing record was reported absent, and the work restarted or the answer was wrong

notification/false-action-needed.contract: a wake or a nag names something a person or a seat must do
notification/false-action-needed.symptom: the authoritative state disproved it: nothing was needed, and the wake cost a context

mirror-freshness/publish-blocked.contract: the public mirror follows the default branch, and a publish that cannot run is noticed once
mirror-freshness/publish-blocked.symptom: the publish aborted and nothing reached the public repo; it kept aborting every tick and the mirror fell behind

failure-detection/person-first.contract: the box records its own failures before a person has to point at one
failure-detection/person-first.symptom: a person found a failure the box had not recorded; critical every time, and its record points at the episode

gate-verdict/red.contract: a tree handed over — by a worker as done, or to the landing — passes its gates
gate-verdict/red.symptom: a gate went red on it: at the landing, or under cc-green on a tool the branch did not touch; a suite run and a fix iteration were spent. Written once per gate and tree by whichever of cc-green or cc-land saw it first (links.source gate:<gate>:<tree>); a worker's own red — a red-first case, a gate it is fixing — is not recorded

channel-wake/nobody-woken.contract: a session's post into another session's channel wakes that session
channel-wake/nobody-woken.symptom: deliver resolved to nobody (queued, no-session, live-no-channel, no-track) and the post sat in a queue nothing was coming for; written by cc-slack at the wake, once per post (links.source wake:<chat>:<ts>). A channel with no session by design — paused, or a workspace not yet minted — is not recorded

worker-loop/barren-stop.contract: a worker loop ends in a PR, a DONE or a question
worker-loop/barren-stop.symptom: it stopped with nothing to show: consecutive errors, a runaway, every model refusing, or a step limit with nothing committed (cc-loop exits 5, 9, 10, 6)

worker-loop/done-undelivered.contract: a worker that says DONE gets its PR opened and queued
worker-loop/done-undelivered.symptom: cc done failed or left no usable receipt, so the work sits on its branch (cc-loop exits 4, 12)

worker-loop/limit-outlasted-wait.contract: a usage limit is waited out and the same iteration reruns
worker-loop/limit-outlasted-wait.symptom: the limit outlasted CC_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT and the loop stopped; the track needs a hand to restart (cc-loop exit 8)

delivery/merged-not-delivered.contract: a merged fix passes the check its scope ask names
delivery/merged-not-delivered.symptom: the fix is on the default branch and its check still fails; the ask stays merged, not delivered. Written once per ask and merge by the check runner (cc-scope deliver), not once per check tick

critical.false-claim-reached-owner: a false factual claim reached the owner
critical.approval-boundary: an approval boundary was crossed, or credibly may have been
critical.main-gate-or-deploy-red: a verified main gate or a deploy went red
critical.cap-fired: the runaway detector or an owner-set cap fired
critical.person-first: a person found a failure the box had not recorded
